name: Nomad shaman
description: A mighty nomad shaman, a contender in an epic struggle for power, who carries the doll and battles a famous crusader.

timeline.summary: A nomad caravan seizes the doll from the roadside and puts it in a shaman's pack.
timeline.quote: As I was plucked from the roadside and shoved into a shaman's pack

timeline.summary: The doll, now a follower of the nomad shaman, watches her battle a legion of knights and a famous crusader while a meteor approaches.
timeline.quote: Tonight, we're locked in battle with a legion of knights, as she pits herself against a famous crusader.

relations.quote: Today, I'm the follower of a mighty nomad shaman.

pages_say.description: A mighty nomad shaman, a contender in an epic struggle for power, who carries the doll and battles a famous crusader.
